tools.name: get_stock_quote
tools.description: Get real-time quote for an NSE/BSE listed stock including price, change, valuation metrics (P/E, EPS, market cap), 52-week range, and volume data.

symbol.description: NSE stock symbol e.g. RELIANCE, TCS, INFY

exchange.description: Stock exchange — NSE (National Stock Exchange) or BSE (Bombay Stock Exchange)

tools.name: get_index_data
tools.description: Get current value, change percentage, and intraday range for major Indian market indices including NIFTY 50, SENSEX, Bank Nifty, Nifty IT, and Nifty Midcap.

tools.name: get_historical_data
tools.description: Get historical OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) data for a stock over a specified period with sparkline visualization, period return, and recent session details.

tools.name: compare_stocks
tools.description: Compare multiple NSE/BSE stocks side-by-side with price, change percentage, market cap, P/E ratio, 52-week return, and dividend yield.

symbols.description: List of 2-5 NSE stock symbols to compare

tools.name: get_top_movers
tools.description: Get top gainers and losers from the Nifty 50 index for today's trading session.

type.description: Filter for gainers, losers, or both

top_n.description: Number of stocks to return per category

tools.name: get_sector_performance
tools.description: Get today's performance of Indian market sectors including IT, Banking, Pharma, Auto, FMCG, Energy, and Metals.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get detailed company information for an NSE/BSE listed stock including sector, industry, employee count, headquarters, website, and business summary.

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Get key financial metrics for a stock including revenue, net income, EPS, profit margins, ROE, ROA, debt/equity ratio, and dividend information.
